headline: Gentle AI can review this change before you call it done.
reason: Review can help detect execution issues in these changes.
value: Reviewing takes a little longer and makes the result safer.

choices.label: Review this change
choices.effect: Reviews only this change; later medium- or high-risk changes ask again, and delivery needs separate approval.
choices.invocation: gentle-ai review start --contract gentle-ai.review-integration/v2 --cwd /repo --target sha256:136dc6556e3bac8c2e7f7af7cc5ec361f449e383a997638128729059fefa06a5 --projection workspace --lineage review-consent-fixture --consent granted

choices.label: Skip this time
choices.effect: Skips only this change; no review record is created, and future reviews stay enabled.
choices.invocation: gentle-ai review start --contract gentle-ai.review-integration/v2 --cwd /repo --target sha256:136dc6556e3bac8c2e7f7af7cc5ec361f449e383a997638128729059fefa06a5 --projection workspace --lineage review-consent-fixture --consent declined

off_path.note: To turn reviews off for good, run 'gentle-ai review mode disable'.
